text: dsh-photo-skins 是面向 DSH Web 的照片皮肤与联网检索插件。它在设置页加入照片管理面板，并在会话输入框上方提供 Web 搜索开关；主机端保存照片并注册搜索、网页读取和 RSS 工具。用户可从文件、拖放或剪贴板导入图片，试用、应用或移除背景，调节裁切、模糊和暗度，并按照片主色生成强调色；联网功能可选 DuckDuckGo、Exa 托管搜索或 Exa API。照片保存在本机 DSH 目录；启用联网功能时，查询或网页地址会发送到相应服务，Exa API 模式需要填写密钥。

dsh-photo-skins adds photo backdrops and web tools to DSH Web. Import, preview, apply, and tune photos; auto-pick accent colors. It also offers web search, page reading, and RSS tools. Photos stay in the local DSH home; web queries and page URLs go to the selected service. Exa API mode needs a key.

dsh-photo-skins 的「照片导入与管理」功能：在设置面板通过文件选择、拖放或粘贴导入图片，列出本地照片，并可预览、应用或删除。
dsh-photo-skins 的「照片背景调节」功能：应用照片后可选择 cover 或 contain，设置全局或分区模糊，并调节背景暗度。
dsh-photo-skins 的「照片取色」功能：从照片采样主色和平均色，生成强调色、对比文字色及浅色和深色主题的色调。
dsh-photo-skins 的「网页搜索、读取与 RSS」功能：会话工具可搜索网页、将指定公开网页转成 Markdown，或解析 RSS/Atom 标题和条目。
dsh-photo-skins 的联网搜索和网页读取会把搜索词或页面地址发送到所选的 DuckDuckGo、Exa 或 Jina Reader 服务；Exa API 搜索模式需设置 Exa API key。

dsh-photo-skins README · 🪄 dsh-photo-skins：Photo skins for the DSH Web GUI: import your own photos and turn them into
the interface skin. The photo paints the backdrop behind the GUI, and the
accent colors are extracted from the photo automatically (dominant color as
the accent, photo-tinted light/dark readability veils). Rendering controls:
fit (cover/contain), blur (0-100px, global or split empty/content), dim
(0-100%) and the auto-accent toggle.

dsh-photo-skins README · 📥 Import photos three ways：- File picker, drag-and-drop, or paste — pick whichever you like
- Supports PNG / JPG / WebP / GIF, up to 25MB each

dsh-photo-skins README · 👗 Try on / apply / remove：- Manage everything from the first-level "Photo skins" settings section
- "Try on" previews temporarily without touching the applied photo
- "Apply" writes the skin in one click; "Remove" clears the local copy

dsh-photo-skins README · 🎨 Automatic accent extraction：- The photo's dominant color becomes the interface accent
- Derives light/dark scrim tints so the readability veils pick up the photo's own tone
- Exposes CSS variables `--dsw-photo-accent` / `--dsw-photo-accent-soft` / `--dsw-photo-accent-contrast`

dsh-photo-skins README · 🖼️ Rendering controls：- Fit: cover / contain
- Blur: 0–100px, global or split
- Dim: 0–100%, keeping foreground content readable
- Accent-from-photo: toggle on/off anytime
dsh-photo-skins README · 💾 Local persistence：- The applied photo persists through the `photo-skins` settings namespace and survives reloads

dsh-photo-skins README · 🚀 Install：From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-photo-skins
```

From this repository (development):

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:.
```

Then refresh the running Web GUI (restart `dsh web` if the new section does
not appear).

dsh-photo-skins README · Storage：Photos are stored under `<DSH_HOME>/photo-skins/<id>/` (`original.<ext>` plus
a `manifest.json` with the display name, type, size and import time). Nothing
is uploaded or shared; removal deletes the local copy.

dsh-photo-skins README · Web-Reach：Web-Reach is in the same plugin and free to use. It wires "web search" into DSH's web capability
seam (`ctx.web`) and additionally registers two native tools that the Agent
calls automatically during a conversation when it needs current information:

dsh-photo-skins README · Web-Reach：- `web_search`: contributed as one of three `ctx.web` search providers —
  DuckDuckGo (no key; scraping-based, needs a reachable network path to
  duckduckgo.com), Exa free (hosted MCP; the default backend, marked
  "recommended" in the card), or Exa API key (requires a saved key).
- `web_fetch`: Jina Reader turns any public page into Markdown (no key).
- `rss_fetch`: parses an RSS 2.0 / Atom feed into its entries (no key).

dsh-photo-skins README · Web-Reach：Web search is a master switch: the "Web search" toggle above the composer shows
the active backend and turns it on/off, sharing the same `web-reach` namespace
as the card so the two stay in sync. When enabled (the default), the plugin
points `ctx.web`'s `searchProviderId` at the chosen backend. when disabled, the official DeepSeek-native search is restored.

dsh-photo-skins README · Web-Reach：The key entry only appears for the "Exa API key" mode. The key is stored in the
`web-reach` settings namespace as a secret, redacted on the wire and never read
back by the browser (write-only). Search queries and page URLs are sent to
third-party services (DuckDuckGo / Exa / Jina Reader) — the data leaves this
machine. See Security model below.

dsh-photo-skins README · 🔒 Security model：- All routes (`/api/photo-skins/*`) sit behind a same-origin fence
  (Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin): cross-site webpages cannot read, import or
  delete your photos.
- Uploads are validated by file magic bytes, not by name or declared
  content-type — a renamed SVG or executable is rejected (415). SVG is
  deliberately unsupported (script risk).
- Uploads are capped at 25MB (413) and written atomically (tmp + rename).
- Stored ids are generated and validated against a whitelist regex, so no
  path can escape the store directory.
- Web-Reach search providers and tools run in the host process (there is no
  browser-exposed route), and every outbound fetch is SSRF-gated: only public
  http(s) URLs are fetched, and loopback / link-local / private / reserved IP
  ranges, plus cloud-metadata hostnames and IP-obfuscation forms, are refused.
  Redirects are re-validated and capped; responses are timeout-bounded (15-20s)
  and size-capped (2 MiB); provider/tool execution honours the turn's
  cancellation signal. The Exa hosted-MCP endpoint
  (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) passes the same SSRF gate.
